title: Synthesis of Data-Driven Decision Support, Investor Behavior, and Applied Technical Methodologies
research_question: How do diverse technical and behavioral methodologies—ranging from predictive modeling in telecommunications to human-AI interaction frameworks—contribute to decision-making and optimization?
executive_summary: This report synthesizes three distinct areas: technical churn prediction, behavioral insights into financial advising, and practical software development. While the provided documents vary significantly in focus—from technical PySpark-based customer churn prediction to behavioral finance and professional qualification profiles—they collectively highlight the increasing reliance on data-driven approaches to solve operational and cognitive challenges. The report identifies that effective modeling relies heavily on data cleaning and feature engineering, while decision-support systems must account for the nuance of human-AI reliance.

paper_analyses.title: Telco Customer Churn Prediction (INT315 Project Report)
paper_analyses.objective: To build an end-to-end data processing, exploratory analysis, and machine learning pipeline using PySpark to predict telecommunications customer churn [INT315REPORT.pdf, Page 8, Para 1].
paper_analyses.methodology: Preprocessing using Spark SQL for null handling/casting, feature engineering with StringIndexer and OneHotEncoder, and model training using PySpark MLlib Logistic Regression [INT315REPORT.pdf, Page 8, Para 1].
findings: Identified 7,032 usable records after cleaning [INT315REPORT.pdf, Page 8, Para 1].
Demonstrated the effectiveness of Logistic Regression in classifying churn behavior [INT315REPORT.pdf, Page 10, Para 1].

paper_analyses.title: Resume of Pranav Kumar

paper_analyses.title: Review of Financial Advisor and Investor Behavior Literature
paper_analyses.objective: To survey factors influencing investment decisions and human-AI reliance [Sample-Research-Papers-for-Prposed-Research-Journal.pdf, Page 11, Para 1].
paper_analyses.methodology: Qualitative and quantitative analysis of investor behavior and NLP application in financial coaching [Sample-Research-Papers-for-Prposed-Research-Journal.pdf, Page 11, Para 1].
findings: Transparency policies in advisory markets may backfire under strategic commitment [Sample-Research-Papers-for-Prposed-Research-Journal.pdf, Page 11, Para 1].
Introduction of 'Appropriate Reliance' as a key metric for human-AI interaction [Sample-Research-Papers-for-Prposed-Research-Journal.pdf, Page 11, Para 1].

methodology_comparison.comparison: INT315 employs distributed computing (PySpark) for large-scale tabular data cleaning, whereas the financial literature survey emphasizes qualitative/psychological modeling and behavioral NLP insights.
Machine learning projects (INT315) use objective metrics (Accuracy, ROC-AUC), while behavioral research focuses on conceptual frameworks like 'Appropriate Reliance'.

critiques.critique: The technical report is highly focused on implementation but lacks discussion on the sociological implications of churn prediction, such as algorithm bias.
The literature summary provides a broad overview but [UNCERTAIN] lacks detailed performance data for the specific models cited in the behavioral studies.

research_gaps.title: Integration of Behavioral Insights into ML Pipelines
research_gaps.description: Current ML pipelines focus on objective data, ignoring the subjective behavioral factors that drive decision-making.
potential_directions: Incorporate psychological features into churn models.
